motifs.name: upper_craggy_mountains
motifs.description: The broad upper band of jagged, layered mountain and hillside forms spanning the left and center, including the large central peak, smaller adjoining ridges, clustered boulders, and pale receding crags.
must_preserve: dry ink contour lines defining crag profiles
cun-style rubbing and textured washes on rock faces
dark crevice accents between overlapping peaks
